“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”
“federal goverment's” >>> “federal government's”
“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
“three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are stated, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”
“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”
“directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: Section 5’s daily civil penalty is given as $1 million earlier; confirm the amount and whether the amendment changes it.]
“who's support” >>> “whose support”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”
“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, not the stated 28 members.]
“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Only five senators are listed, but six are described as undecided. Also reconcile the list with the later descriptions of Kowalski and Ames.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: The timeline dates the committee hearing to September 30; confirm whether these are different hearings.]
“a seperate interview” >>> “a separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”
“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”
“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”
“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”
“would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies 18 months, not two years. Confirm the deadline and whether it requires negotiations to conclude.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“there senators” >>> “their senators”
“recieve updated notes” >>> “receive updated notes”
“Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: The coverage plan earlier says there are six Hill reporters.]
